Database Schema¶

This section documents the Kibble database schema in UML format.

Overview¶

The database stores information about:

  • devices

  • device types

  • protocol events

  • status

Entities¶

DeviceInfo¶

  • device_ip

  • hostname

  • mac_address

  • device_type_id

DeviceType¶

  • name

  • supported_protocols

Status¶

  • alive

  • latency_ms

  • last_updated_ms

ProtocolEvent¶

  • _id

  • device_id

  • protocol

  • timestamp
